body.text:
Hi David,

The heating in my flat is broken since Monday, it is very cold in the night. You must send someone to repair it this week. When it can be fixed?

Best,
Maple

* * *

Hi David,

Sorry, I didn't mean to be rude. I understand the engineers are busy. Is it possible to know roughly which day they can come? I am at home every morning, so any morning is ok for me.

Thanks,
Maple

Email from Greenway Lettings. Subject: Welcome to your new flat

Welcome! If anything needs fixing, just email this address and we'll get back to you within two working days.

Kind regards,
David, Greenway Lettings

out.ref: I [do need] you [to arrange for] someone to [come out] and [fix] it this week.
alts: Could you please get someone out to sort it this week? I really need it done by then.

out.construct: I do need you to + verb (我确实需要你……)

why.label: do need
why.note: 英文里对房东说 must 像下命令，读者会防备。I do need you to 同样坚定，但它是在说明自己的需要，而不是指使对方，所以更有礼貌。比如 I do need the boiler looked at this week 也可以，但这里要保留对房东的请求感。

why.label: arrange for someone to come out
why.note: 中文的“派人来修”直译成 send someone to repair 很生硬，英国租客通常说 arrange for someone to come out，意思是安排人上门。come out 指工人到房子里来，比 come 更具体。

why.label: fix
why.note: repair 偏正式，像说明书；日常邮件里租客更常用 fix，语气更自然，也不显得在对房东摆架子。

note.phrase: arrange for someone to come out
note.meaning: 安排工人上门（来处理问题）
note.usage: 租客、住户请房东、物业或服务方安排人到家里来修理或检查时常用，口语和书面邮件都自然。直接说 send someone to repair 偏直译且生硬，arrange for someone to come out 更像英国人的说法。

examples.t: Could you arrange for someone to come out and look at the boiler this week?
examples.n: 这周能否安排人上门看一下锅炉？

examples.t: We arranged for someone to come out and clean the carpets before the guests arrived.
examples.n: 客人到之前，我们安排了人上门清洗地毯。

examples.t: The bank will arrange for someone to come out and check the cash machine.
examples.n: 银行会安排人上门检查这台取款机。
